question: Which śaktis are named in this part of the worship list?
premises: Kṛtyā, Kāntā, and Kalitā are named.
A śakti named Kautā is included.
inference: This part of the list includes Kṛtyā, Kāntā, Kalitā, Kautā, and Kirātikā.
plain_english: One should worship Kṛtyā, Kāntā, Kalitā, the one named Kautā, and Kirātikā.
